title: Eight Sleep athletes track
description: A pale-grey band of endorsements: a two-line centered heading that fades up, a row of partner names separated by thin vertical rules (sliding as a marquee on phones), then an endless slow track of tall rounded athlete photo cards with a black scrim at the bottom, a narrow-serif quote in white, the athlete's name and a tiny role line.
notes: partner 'logos' are plain text (pass styled wordmarks as nodes)
one 309×466 photo slot per card; the cards are dark-scoped so text stays white
name: eightsleep-athletes
